ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is an 18-gon, with each vertex marked by a black dot. The top vertex is labeled P; near a vertex at the lower right is labeled 18; near a vertex at the lower left is labeled 20. Counting clockwise starting from the vertex where P is located, 18 corresponds to the position after the 7th vertex, namely x7; 20 corresponds to the position after the 11th vertex, namely x11. Reasoning: Let the values of the 18 vertices clockwise from P be x0, x1, ..., x17, where x0 = P = a, x1 = b. The problem states that the number at each vertex equals the sum of the numbers at the two adjacent vertices, so x_i = x_{i-1} + x_{i+1}, equivalently x_{i+1} = x_i - x_{i-1}. Starting the recurrence from x0=a, x1=b: x2=b-a, x3=-a, x4=-b, x5=a-b, x6=a, x7=b. Therefore the sequence cycles every 6 terms, with pattern a, b, b-a, -a, -b, a-b. From the positions in the figure, x7=18. Since x7=b, b=18. Also x11 is congruent to x5, and x11=a-b=20. Thus a-18=20, obtaining a=38. Therefore the vertex P should be written as 38.
